people.name: Jack Andrew Barker
people.source: Form ADV Schedule B (indirect owner of JUNCTURE, INC.)
people.bio_note: Chief Fiduciary Officer / Chief Compliance Officer at Juncture Wealth Strategies (JD, CPA, CTFA). Over 20 years of experience in tax consulting, wealth planning, and trust administration for high-net-worth clients. Career includes implementing tax strategies at a national accounting firm, supervising client relationships at an asset management practice, and managing trust operations at a multinational bank. Holds a J.D. from the University of Nebraska College of Law (1994); joined Juncture in 2013.
people.bio_source: Firm website (juncturewealth.com/about/team) corroborated by Juncture's 2024 Form ADV Part 2B Brochure Supplement and Bloomberg Markets profile (bloomberg.com/profile/person/19154180)

people.name: Barry Scott Rhonemus
people.source: Form ADV Schedule B (indirect owner of JUNCTURE, INC.)
people.bio_note: Managing Partner and Founder of Juncture Wealth Strategies. Over 20 years of experience serving ultra-high-net-worth clients, family offices, foundations, and corporate entities. The firm's own site states he spent more than a decade as a private bank wealth advisor at Wells Fargo, ranking in the Top 10 of Wells Fargo Private Bank Wealth Advisors nationally, before founding Juncture in 2010 -- this specific ranking claim is self-reported by the firm and could not be independently corroborated (see source note). Holds a bachelor's degree from Ohio University (1984-1988).
people.bio_source: juncturewealth.com/barry-rhonemus-3 (firm's own site, states the Wells Fargo Top 10 claim verbatim). Phase 4 verification (2026-07-03): his LinkedIn profile (linkedin.com/in/barry-rhonemus-12b9883b), previously cited as corroborating this claim, does NOT mention Wells Fargo at all -- the ranking claim is self-reported by the firm only, not independently confirmed. Ohio University education separately corroborated.

people.name: Bradley James Haines
people.source: Form ADV Schedule B (indirect owner of JUNCTURE, INC.)
people.bio_note: Chief Investment Officer at Juncture Wealth Strategies (CFA, FRM). Over 20 years of experience managing investment portfolios for high-net-worth individuals and institutional clients, with expertise in valuing privately held companies and researching asset/risk allocation strategies. Prior experience includes roles at Wells Fargo, LeMaster & Daniels PLLC (now CliftonLarsonAllen LLP), and Merrill Lynch.
people.bio_source: Firm website (juncturewealth.com/about/team) corroborated by LinkedIn (linkedin.com/in/bradhainescfafrm/) listing prior roles at Wells Fargo, LeMaster & Daniels, and Merrill Lynch

firm_note.text: Juncture Wealth Strategies was founded in 2010 by Barry Rhonemus after he and colleagues left Wells Fargo Private Bank to go independent; the firm serves ultra-high-net-worth individuals, family offices, foundations, and corporate entities. A related advisory entity, Juncture Asset Management, LLC (est. 2019), is also owned by Rhonemus, Barker, and Haines.
